name: Ayşe Erkmen
art_institution: Akademie der Künste (Berlin), Arter (Istanbul), Auckland Art Space, The Contemporary Austin, Barbican Centre (London), Bonniers Konsthall (Stockholm), Centre Pompidou (Paris), Hamburger Bahnhof–Museum für Gegenwart–Berlin, Hamburger Kunsthalle, Istanbul Modern, Saidaiji Temple (Nara), SALT (Istanbul), SMAK (Gent) and Tanas (Berlin)
theme: Social and physical environment, architectural and social conditions and contexts, water purification, city-planning, sociological issues
object: Rooms, walls, floors, ceilings, windows, doors, basements, building facades, roofs, overhead lights, a skylight and an elevator, connected colored pipes, underwater bridge made of ocean cargo containers, steel beams, and steel grates
